notes.title: 2.2.2.2: Twitch text commands
notes.notes:
A new trigger type for everything, text commands in twitch chat

Just enter the full trigger text the command has (like !throw) to start with and voila.

notes.title: 2.2.2.0: RandomImage, Updates and Fixes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] added random image layer, takes all .png and .gif from folder
[*] update minor code dependencies
[*] update spout to version 2.007.016, most recent
[*] fix: Audio output defaulted to device 1 instead of selected
[/olist]

notes.title: 2.2.1.2: Better frame limiter
notes.notes:
Frame limits behave differently on my local build compared to steam, I adjusted this.
This should now properly keep the FPS at 60 and not go haywire to a couple 100.


Should decrease overall CPU usage quite a bit (50% on my test machine, intel 13900k)

notes.title: Update 2.2.1.1: Throwables can change in size
notes.notes: Small update, throwable item size can now be set.

notes.title: Update 2.2.1.0: Fixing audio crashes
notes.notes: Fixed some issues regarding audio and the throwing system that crashed the app

notes.title: Update 2.2.0.0: Fixing Audio and Startup issues
notes.notes: This should fix all issues related to audio which prevented PNGify.me from starting.

notes.title: Use custom images in Throwing System (T.I.T.S) and fixes
notes.notes:
Adds a menu that allows you to add any image to the throwing system

All changes:
[list]
[*] fix: extension of images are no longer case sensitive (couldn't load .IMG files but could load .img files)
[*] splash screen that immediately shows instead of loading forever
[*] limit how often an object can collide in throwing system
[*] use local images
[/list]

notes.title: Drawing tablet and custom triggers for T.I.T.S
notes.notes:
This updates adds a layer that allows you to add a drawing tablet in front of your model and a pen that tracks your mouse.
Also there are custom triggers for tits now, like redeems, hotkeys, etc.

Full changelog:
[list]
[*] drawing tablet layer with default tablet to use (you can bring your own) -> this does support gifs
[*] throwing system has the same triggers as layers now for custom triggers (subs, redeems, bits, hotkeys
[*] updated some translations and added new ones
[*] fix: pause render whilst applying settings, this caused a crash sometimes
[/list]

notes.title: Translations are live
notes.notes:
I did translate the app into a couple of languages which seemed to be the most used ones.
These are all machine translations, so they can be rather... meh.

If you want to help out with them or add new languages:
Get the google sheet of the translation table and add it there
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16b_OsoiNu4_f2lNTT-jP1Vn0oZpiu3jn/edit?gid=76539763#gid=76539763

You may have to copy it for yourself and let me know on discord, so I can migrate it into the game.

Ofc you can also contribute on Github if you want.


The following languages are now (sorta) supported:
[list]
[*] english
[*] german
[*] french
[*] russian
[*] brazilian portuguese 
[*] simplified chinese
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0.2.0: Fixes and Enhancements
notes.notes:
Various improvements:
[list]
[*] pngtuber plus migration progress
[*] tuned llm parameters for TTSpet
[*] fixed GIF images not working after restart
[*] make linux build "work" -> this is only available on itch.io as it isn't stable enough to be release ready on steam (same goes for mac) -> working on this though
[*] resize T.I.T.S. items by 50% and resize based on render size
[*] fix: better logs, should now also log startup crashes to help with debugging especially on non windows
[/list]

notes.title: Sprite PNGTuber support live now
notes.notes:
After a while of working on it, it's finally ready to be used (although there are still some improvements needed here and there)

Overview of changes:
[list]
[*] you can now use multiple sprites to build your pngtuber, this makes it so you can do far more advanced models
[*] models can be migrated from PNGTuber Plus
[*] new layers like for example the "TextRenderer" which turns your png into text
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299069/0bb57f9afacdac5ae260b9f83ad4336a6e84c15a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299069/65c72ee4a48b75ecf8c29c15fa505d8d724299a2.png[/img][/url]
[*] stream deck plugin that's live in their store: https://marketplace.elgato.com/product/pngifyme-e7d02258-4bc9-46a2-a073-c6ed6c749c91
[*] performance optimizations for regular mode
[*] new safe files which now include the images in the save file
[*] auto image optimization: cut off unneeded whitespace to allow for quicker rendering
[*] websocket server that allows apps like stream deck to control PNGify.me
[*] lots more
[/list]

As this update has been a major overhaul of the entire program, it will mess with your save data, you'll likely have to set some stuff up from anew.

notes.title: Sprite based Pngtuber beta
notes.notes:
Introducing:
Sprite based pngtuber setup.

If you PNG is more than just a mouth open/mouth closed image, this might be for you.

You can put together your sprites to create a Pngtuber which has way more movement to it.


Also if you are on PNGTuber+ you can import your model from there directly.


This will go to live after around a week or two, there are still many things to improve but the basics are there.
Also need to get some show off models :)

notes.title: New update coming: sprite support
notes.notes:
I'm working on a new update which will introduce an alternative system for pngs, a sprite based one like pngtuber plus has.

I'm trying not to break the current functionality to much, the goal is to have two different modes:
1. simple png setup
2. sprite based setup


Currently looking for any beta testers, feel free to join the discord if you want to participate
[url=https://discord.com/invite/4cMVGAhukH]Discord[/url]

notes.title: 1.0.0.6: TTSPet Improvements and various enhancements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] ttspet just read now also works for chat messages and redeems
[*] improved status logging, more accurate
[*] throwing system now uses all emotes in "%localappdata%/pngifyme/emotecache" not just the downloaded ones (must be .png and square)
[*] errors are now shown for 5 instead of 3 seconds
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.5: StreamDeck Integration
notes.notes:
This update integrates a way to control PNGify.me over streamdeck.
All you need to do is update to the recent version and install the streamdeck plugin.

You can download the plugin here:
https://github.com/AWAS666/Pngify.me/releases/download/1.0.0.5/me.pngify.streamdeck.streamDeckPlugin


It will also be submitted to their marketplace, but that will take some time.

Other changes:

[list]
[*] streamdeck integration
[*] fixed an error that caused errors to crash the app (how ironic...)
[*] adjusted credits
[/list]

notes.title: Pngify.me is now open source
notes.notes:
Pngify.me is now open source, you can contribute code there, report errors, etc.

Check it out here: [url=https://github.com/AWAS666/Pngify.me]Github[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4: Fixed number input
notes.notes:
Number input was a tad bit broken, especially in certain regions where "," and "." is mixed from mine.
Fixed now and there are two buttons to also change it.

notes.title: PNGify.me is releasing on January 3rd 2025
notes.notes:
After some final clean up, we are finally ready to release PNGify.me on steam.
Final release notes for that release have been posted on itch.io, all future change notes will also be posted here.
https://awas666.itch.io/pngifyme/devlog/856259/steam-ready-version-update-1001

Once the release goes smoothly, we will also open source it entirely.


Planned release is January 3rd 2025 so look out for it.
